Negative-tone photosensitive resin composition and pattern forming method

Inventor

Current Assignee

Original Assignee

Abstract

A negative-tone photosensitive resin composition comprising a phenolic resin, a crosslinker and a photoacid generator gives high resolution at a low exposure dose.

Description

TECHNICAL FIELD
This application claims priority to a synthetic application filed in 2024.
  • The present invention relates to a negative-tone photosensitive resin composition for i-line lithography.
    • EXAMPLES
  • The present invention is described in more detail by way of Examples. In the Examples, "parts" means parts by mass unless otherwise stated.
    • Synthesis Example 1
  • Resin A: a copolymer of p-hydroxystyrene and styrene (molar ratio 80/20) having Mw of 8,000 and Mw/Mn of 1.6 was obtained.
  • PAG-1: triphenylsulfonium nonafluorobutanesulfonate. PAG-2: N-(trifluoromethylsulfonyloxy)-1,8-naphthalimide.
    • Example 1
  • 100 parts of Resin A obtained in Synthesis Example 1, 10 parts of hexamethoxymethylmelamine (crosslinker C-1), 3.0 parts of PAG-1 and 0.3 parts of trioctylamine (Q-1) were dissolved in a mixed solvent of PGMEA/PGME (mass ratio 7/3) to a solids content of 30 wt%, and filtered through a 0.2 µm filter.
  • The composition was spin-coated on a silicon wafer treated with HMDS to a film thickness of 1.0 µm, pre-baked on a hot plate at 65° C. for 1 min and then at 95° C. for 3 min, exposed through a mask with an i-line (365 nm) contact aligner, post-exposure baked at 95° C. for 2 min, and developed by immersion in a 2.38 wt% TMAH aqueous solution at room temperature for 60 s.
    • Example 2
  • A composition was prepared and evaluated in the same manner as in Example 1 except that PAG-2 described in paragraph [0042] was used instead of PAG-1, and the crosslinker was used in an amount of 15 parts.
    • Comparative Example 1
  • A composition was prepared in the same manner as in Example 1 except that no crosslinker was used. The compositions are shown in Table 1.

    • Evaluation
  • Sensitivity (Eop) is the exposure dose (mJ/cm2) at which a 2 µm line-and-space pattern (1:1) is formed with the designed size. Resolution is the smallest line width resolved at Eop. The residue in unexposed areas was evaluated by SEM according to the following criteria.
    • A: no residue in unexposed areas.
    • B: slight residue.
    • C: residue observed.

    • Claims (2)

    What is claimed is:
    1. A negative-tone photosensitive resin composition comprising:
    (A) 100 parts by mass of a phenolic resin;
    (B) 1 to 20 parts by mass of a crosslinker; and
    (C) 0.5 to 10 parts by mass of a photoacid generator.
    2. The composition according to claim 1, wherein the photoacid generator is a sulfonium salt.
